observedFailures.failure: The progress/liveness surfaces were positioned near the page top, so showing them pulled the participant away from the current interaction and required a second scroll to recover the active control.
observedFailures.mechanism: INFORMATION-LOCATION/FOCUS COUPLING: a global status surface was treated as a navigation target instead of contextual information adjacent to the current action.
observedFailures.lesson: Persistent progress should remain visible near the active interaction; liveness feedback must not create a two-scroll round trip.

observedFailures.failure: A locally complete measurement area could be converted into a participant-facing synthesis even when the synthesis mostly repackaged the participant's immediately preceding answer.
observedFailures.mechanism: MEASUREMENT-COMPLETION/SYNTHESIS CONFLATION: the runtime had a way to ask more questions or surface a pattern, but no distinct successful state for 'enough measurement information, no useful person-level synthesis.'
observedFailures.lesson: Scientific coverage can close without manufacturing a named Life Pattern. Reserve participant adjudication for syntheses that add meaningful person-specific integration rather than obvious paraphrase.

observedFailures.failure: Pattern-decision buttons could remain disabled while the UI showed 'Working on it' because participant adjudication synchronously waited on another model-driven coverage assessment.
observedFailures.mechanism: LOCAL-DECISION/REMOTE-ENRICHMENT COUPLING: a deterministic participant judgment was made dependent on a slower auxiliary LLM operation that had already been performed at synthesis time.
observedFailures.lesson: Commit the participant decision using already-cached coverage metadata; do not make an authoritative local action wait on redundant remote enrichment.
